create_image_pixen: 1 generation. 96×144 is supported (dimensions are multiples of 4; total area is within the limit); `view="side"`, `direction="south"`, and `no_background=True` are supported. It has no style-reference or palette input parameters.

Free lookups: `get_balance`, `list_jobs`, `get_image`, and `search_help`.

Older raw-image jobs: `list_images` lists Creator gallery images, not raw jobs. Retrieve a raw-image result with `get_image(job_id)` if you have its job ID.
